high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram Explore page, featuring a post by the user "vintagelart." The post showcases an illustration of a character wearing a black, form-fitting costume with cat-like ears on the headpiece. The character's pose is confident, with one arm crossed over the chest. The background is a solid peach or light orange color. The character has a speech bubble that reads, "I'd rather have a cold heart than a broken one," which adds a dramatic and somewhat melancholic tone to the image.
